chapter_name: Universal Franchise and India's Electoral System
learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the super-power of voting, explore how India's massive elections work, and understand why every single vote matters in a democracy!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🗳️ The Magic of Universal Adult Franchise
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In India, every citizen who is 18 years or older has the right to vote. This is called Universal Adult Franchise. It means everyone gets one equal vote, no matter their wealth, education, gender, or religion!
To make elections fair and easy, the country is divided into smaller areas called constituencies. People in each constituency vote to elect one candidate who will represent them in the government.

Voting is completely secret! Nobody can force you to tell them who you voted for. Today, instead of paper ballots, India uses Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) where you just press a button next to your favorite candidate's symbol.

Elections give power to the people. If citizens are unhappy with their leaders, they can vote for someone else in the next election. It is the ultimate tool to keep the government working for the public good.

fun_activity.title: ⚡ Host a Family Election
fun_activity.instructions: Set up a secret voting box at home! Create paper ballots and ask your family members to vote on what to have for Sunday dinner or which movie to watch. Count the votes and announce the democratic winner!

quick_recap: ⭐ Universal Adult Franchise gives every citizen aged 18 and above the equal right to vote.
⭐ The Election Commission of India ensures that elections are free, fair, and organized.
⭐ Voting allows citizens to choose their leaders and actively participate in the democratic process.
